# DirectiveCard

One thing the engine is doing or suggesting right now: icon, short label, and the reason in plain words.

`CLR.DirectiveCard` · Coaching

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.DirectiveCard type="recommend_break" reason="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.DirectiveCard" type="recommend_break" reason="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

One item in DirectivesFeed. Maps from ActionDirective.

## Props (DirectiveCardProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` * | `"recommend_break" \| "suppress_notifications" \| "block_distracting_tabs" \| "suggest_task" \| "shorten_focus_interval" \| "delay_hard_tasks" \| "schedule_hard_task" \| "allow_notifications"` |  |
| `reason` * | `string` | Plain-English reason, written as what CLR is doing for you. |
| `label` | `string` | Override the label (defaults to the exact domain label). |

| `action` | `{ label: string; onClick: () => void }` | Optional single action ("Pause", "Edit", "Start break"). |
| `isNew` | `boolean` | Arrived in the last tick: fades in and gets a 4s soft highlight. |
